'''Model TT4 Holorecording Macrobinoculars''' were a series of holorecording [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] manufactured by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]]. Like most macrobinoculars, the TT4's had an internal readout system that provided information on distance and elevation. The TT4's were also capable of recording and playing back what the user was viewing, making the earlier models rather expensive.

The TT4s had internal [[Holorecorder/Legends|holo]] and visual recorders that could store three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] worth of imagery on a single, standard [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

They were developed from [[Experimental Holorecording Macrobinoculars|early prototypes]] designed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. They were bulkier than standard macrobinoculars, but were able to record high quality still [[Hologram/Legends|holoimages]]. One hundred images could be stored on a standard [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]].

Each recon squad in the [[Praesitlyn Defense Force]] was given only one pair.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', published in [[1997]], stated that the TT4s were [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] rather than [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The appearance of Holorecording Macrobinoculars in ''[[Jedi Trial]]'' contradicted the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' and ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', which both said that they were only available after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
